salary: Selected candidates for NPSC CTSE 2026 posts are placed on the Government of Nagaland's Pay Matrix levels as specified in the notification. Class-I Gazetted posts (such as Regimental Medical Officer, Assistant Conservator of Forests, SDO posts, Veterinary Assistant Surgeon) are placed at Pay Matrix Level 13 , which represents the highest pay tier in this recruitment. Class-II Gazetted posts are generally at Level 11 or 12 , while Class-III Non-Gazetted posts are at Level 8 .
application_fee: The application fee for the NPSC Combined Technical Services Examination 2026 is straightforward and uniform. The OTR (One Time Registration) itself is completely free of cost - candidates only pay at the examination application stage. The total payable amount is ₹300 as examination fee plus ₹25 as convenience fee , along with applicable payment gateway charges.
